payload.note: Finite repaired-multibubble compactness checkpoint: for every fixed smooth periodic nonnegative denominator F with a finite zero set and repaired jets F(z+y)=|y|^2+P_6,z(y)+O(|y|^8), the family Omega_m=1/(m+F) has Q_F(m)=||E_m||_2^2/||R_m||_2^2 bounded below by some family-dependent c_F>0. Each zero adds 32*pi^2/3 residual concentration, E_m converges strongly in L2, and E_0 cannot vanish because q_0=0 would make 1/F harmonic with finitely many same-sign r^-2 pole fluxes on a torus. The explicit F_16=sum_mu[sin^2 x_mu+(1/3)sin^4 x_mu] has 16 repaired zeros, concentration 512*pi^2/3, exact q_0(pi/2,0,0,0)=-32/9, and weak endpoint Q(infinity)=512/17. Fixed finite bubble splitting is ruled out; growing bubble gases, towers, necks, delocalized correctors, Witten coercivity, interacting H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
